_comment: CONSTRUCTED ILLUSTRATION, NOT EVIDENCE. Hand-built to exhibit the mechanism the model is about. 'service-mesh-ca' sits on every path from the entrypoint to the target but scores LOWER on standalone node risk than 'archive-signing', which no path to the target crosses. The budget affords exactly one of them. Flat asset-priority ranking and a node-only optimizer both choose archive-signing; only the path-aware objective chooses the chokepoint. Do not cite this as a result -- it demonstrates that the mechanism exists, not how often it matters. See docs/FINDINGS.md for measured effects over randomised instances.
